lines.beaver: 어서 와요. 오늘은 어떤 상담을 하고 싶어요?
lines.beaver_en: Welcome. What would you like to talk about today?
lines.beaver_roman: eoseo wayo. oneureun eotteon sangdameul hago sipeoyo?
lines.learner: 요즘 장래성이 있는 직종이 궁금해서 왔어요.
lines.en: I came because I'm curious about occupations with good potential.
lines.roman: yojeum jangnaeseongi inneun jikjongi gunggeumhaeseo wasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Good. Is there a job you're interested in?
lines.learner: 조리사와 조종사 중에 뭐가 더 유망해요?
lines.en: Which is more promising, chef or pilot?
lines.roman: jorisawa jojongsa junge mwoga deo yumanghaeyo?

lines.beaver_en: Chefs have good prospects if they build expertise.
lines.learner: 조리사는 기술을 배울뿐더러 창업도 할 수 있죠?
lines.en: Chefs not only learn skills but can also start a business, right?
lines.roman: jorisaneun gisureul baeulppundeoreo changeopdo hal ssu itjyo?

lines.beaver: 맞아요. 나중에 자영업자가 될 수도 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: Right. You could become self-employed later.
lines.beaver_roman: majayo. najunge jayeongeopjaga doel ssudo isseoyo.
lines.en: But running your own business is risky and it's hard to rest.

lines.beaver_en: That's true in some ways. What about pilots?
lines.en: I heard pilots earn a lot and many have permanent positions.

lines.beaver: 네, 하지만 지원자가 많아서 경쟁이 세요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, but there are many applicants, so competition is tough.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, hajiman jiwonjaga manaseo gyeongjaengi seyo.
lines.en: Jobs are hard to find these days, so there are even more applicants.

lines.learner: 인턴을 하면 전문성도 쌓을 수 있죠?
lines.en: If I do an internship, I can build expertise too, right?
lines.roman: inteoneul hamyeon jeonmunseongdo ssaeul ssu itjyo?

lines.beaver: 네, 성실히 하면 정규직 기회도 생겨요. 다른 꿈은요?
lines.beaver_en: Yes, if you work hard, you may get a permanent job. Any other dreams?
lines.beaver_roman: ne, seongsiri hamyeon jeonggyujik gihoedo saenggyeoyo. dareun kkumeunyo?
lines.en: I used to dream of becoming a teacher or a philosopher.

lines.beaver: 좋네요. 그럼 지금은 뭘 먼저 준비하고 싶어요?
lines.beaver_en: Nice. So what do you want to prepare first now?
lines.beaver_roman: jonneyo. geureom jigeumeun mwol meonjeo junbihago sipeoyo?
lines.learner: 먼저 지원서와 자기소개서를 잘 쓰고 싶어요.
lines.en: First, I want to write a good application and cover letter.
lines.roman: meonjeo jiwonseowa jagisogaeseoreul jal sseugo sipeoyo.

lines.beaver: 좋아요. 다음 주에 함께 써 봐요.
lines.beaver_en: Great. Let's write them together next week.
lines.beaver_roman: joayo. daeum jue hamkke sseo bwayo.
lines.en: Thank you. I'll come back next week.
